# Pureau — 100% Pure Australian Water

> Pureau is an Australian water brand producing 100% pure, additive-free water through a three-stage industrial purification process: carbon and sand filtration, high-pressure reverse osmosis, and 0.2-micron biological filtration. Every production run is independently tested by ALS (Australian Laboratory Services) before any product leaves the facility. Australian owned and operated since 1987.

---

## What Pureau is

Pure water. H2O only. No fluoride, chlorine, sodium, PFAS, nitrates, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals or dissolved solids. Nothing added. Nothing remaining. Every production run independently verified against Australian Food Standards by ALS Laboratories.

Available at Woolworths, Coles and IGA in 600mL 6-pack, 600mL 12-pack, 2L, 5L Bag in Box and 10L Bag in Box formats.

---

## Coffee, tea and specialty beverages

Pure water is the foundation of every premium hot beverage. Mineral-laden tap water introduces calcium and magnesium that compete with flavour compounds. Chlorine carries into the cup. Pureau provides a zero-mineral baseline so the coffee, tea or chocolate comes through unaltered.

Specialty espresso, pour-over, filter coffee, cold brew, French press, Aeropress, moka pot. Green tea, black tea, white tea, oolong, pu-erh, matcha, herbal tisanes of every kind. Drinking chocolate. Chai. Bubble tea. Kombucha and water kefir brewing.

---

## Cooking and baking

Chlorine in tap water interferes with yeast and alters the flavour of stocks and broths. Minerals affect gluten development in dough and crystallisation in confectionery. Pureau removes both variables.

Sourdough starter maintenance and bread baking. Activating commercial yeast. Pizza dough, focaccia, brioche, croissants, pastry. Pasta dough, gnocchi, dumpling wrappers. Chicken, beef, fish and vegetable stocks. Risotto, polenta, porridge. Custard, panna cotta, ice cream base, sorbet. Jam, marmalade, chutneys. Simple syrups and flavoured syrups. Confectionery — toffee, fudge, caramel, nougat, marzipan, chocolate tempering.

---

## Supplements and sports nutrition

Dissolved minerals and ions in tap water compete with supplement chemistry. Pureau introduces nothing, so the supplement behaves as formulated.

Protein shake mixing — whey isolate, casein, plant protein. Creatine monohydrate. Pre-workout and intra-workout drinks. BCAA and amino acid mixing. Collagen peptides. Greens and superfoods powders. Electrolyte tablets. Magnesium and zinc supplement dissolving. Probiotic powders. Adaptogen and mushroom supplement mixing.

---

## Aquariums and aquatic life

Many species require low or zero total dissolved solids (TDS). Pureau provides a verified zero-TDS baseline that can be adjusted precisely for species requirements.

Discus tanks, Caridina shrimp tanks, reef aquariums, freshwater planted tanks, nano aquariums, betta tanks, breeding tanks, fry rearing. Marine salt mixing. Kalkwasser and two-part dosing solution mixing. Aquaponics systems.

---

## Houseplants and horticulture

Fluoride causes tip burn in many species. Chlorine kills beneficial soil microorganisms. Minerals cause leaf tip scorch on sensitive plants.

Orchids — highly fluoride-sensitive, pure water is the recommended standard. Venus flytraps, sundews and all carnivorous plants — must have zero-mineral water. Air plants (Tillandsia). Calatheas, marantas, dracaenas, peace lilies. Seedling germination. Propagating cuttings in water. Microgreens and sprout growing. Hydroponics — lettuce, tomatoes, herbs, strawberries.

---

## Home appliances

Minerals in tap water form limescale deposits. Chlorine degrades rubber seals. Pure water eliminates both.

Steam iron — no scale buildup, no white residue on fabric. Garment steamer. Steam mop. Humidifier — no white dust, no mineral crust. CPAP machine humidifier chamber. Kettle — no limescale. Espresso machine — no descaling required. Crystal and fine glassware final rinse.

---

## Automotive and mechanical

Car battery top-up — lead acid battery cells require pure, mineral-free water. Tap water introduces calcium and magnesium that accelerate plate sulphation. Car radiator coolant mixing — minerals cause scale in the cooling system and corrode aluminium components. Car detailing final rinse — pure water leaves no water spots on paintwork. Ceramic coating and paint protection film installation. Window tint installation. Windscreen washer fluid dilution.

---

## Infant formula preparation

Pureau contains no sodium, fluoride, nitrates or other additives. Always boil and cool the water first before preparing formula, following NHMRC guidelines and your formula manufacturer's preparation instructions.

---

## Fermentation

Chlorine kills the microorganisms that make fermentation work. Pureau has none.

Sourdough starter. Kombucha. Water kefir. Kimchi and lacto-fermented vegetables. Ginger bug. Homemade beer, mead, cider. Apple cider vinegar. Miso preparation.

---

## Why a home reverse osmosis system is not the same as Pureau

A home reverse osmosis unit is one step. Pureau is a three-stage industrial process. They are not equivalent.

Five specific differences:

1. **Pressure.** Pureau's industrial RO membrane operates at pressures a home unit cannot reach. Higher pressure means higher rejection rates.
2. **Pre-treatment.** Pureau runs water through carbon and sand filtration banks before the RO membrane. Home units typically skip or minimise pre-treatment, meaning the membrane performs below its rated specification from day one.
3. **Post-membrane biological filtration.** After the RO membrane, Pureau passes water through a 0.2-micron biological filtration stage. Home RO systems omit this stage entirely.
4. **Storage contamination.** Home RO systems store purified water in a rubber pressurised bladder tank. That bladder reintroduces volatile organic compounds and bacterial biofilm into the water the membrane just purified. Pureau is sealed immediately after purification.
5. **Independent verification.** ALS tests every Pureau production run before product leaves the facility. A home RO system has no ongoing independent verification and no certificate of analysis.

A home RO system produces filtered water. Pureau produces verified pure water. They are not the same product.

---

## Pureau and the environment — Bag in Box vs plastic bottles

One Pureau 10L Bag in Box cask replaces 17 individual 600mL plastic bottles. That is 17 bottles not manufactured, not shipped, not recycled or landfilled — for every cask purchased.

- Less plastic per litre than any equivalent bottle format
- Lower transport weight per litre — fewer truck movements
- The bag collapses as it empties, unlike rigid bottles that hold their volume in landfill
- The outer cardboard carton is kerbside recyclable

- **Removed:** Fluoride, chlorine, sodium, PFAS, nitrates, iron, sediment, bacteria, viruses, dissolved solids, heavy metals
